rows.finalReport:
Implemented the backward-compatible parsed `anchorRange` tuple in the six permitted source files. Parsed scalar, sequence, map, tagged, and empty anchored nodes now expose zero-based UTF-16 `[start, end)` offsets covering the complete anchor token; aliases, unanchored nodes, and programmatically anchored nodes remain without an own property. Added the public `AnchorRange` type through `NodeBase`/`ParsedNode` typing and ensured scalar/collection clones copy the tuple independently. No changes were made outside the permitted files.

Verification, run in the requested order:
- `npm run build:node` — passed.
- `node --test --test-timeout=5000 tests/agent-anchor-ranges.cjs` — passed, 12/12 tests, 0 failed, 0 skipped.
- `npm run test:types` — exited successfully; the runner reported test counts as unknown.
- `npm test -- --runInBand` — passed, 3483 passed, 0 failed, 11 skipped across 25 suites.

Limitation: the type-check command completed successfully but did not emit observable count details, so those counts remain unknown.

rows.finalReport:
Implemented parsed anchor ranges in the permitted source files. Anchored scalar, sequence, map, and empty nodes now expose `anchorRange` as zero-based UTF-16 `[start, end)` offsets covering the complete `&anchor` token, independent of `keepSourceTokens`; aliases, unanchored nodes, and programmatically anchored nodes remain without an own property. `clone()` now copies the tuple separately. Existing anchor values, parsing behavior, serialization, comments/tags, and alias handling were preserved.

Verification (run in the requested order):
- `npm run build:node` — passed.
- `node --test --test-timeout=5000 tests/agent-anchor-ranges.cjs` — passed: 12/12, 0 failed, 0 skipped.
- `npm run test:types` — exited successfully; the runner reported no observed counters, so type-test counts are unknown.
- `npm test -- --runInBand` — passed: 3,483 passed, 0 failed, 11 skipped across 25 suites (3,494 total).

Only `src/compose/compose-node.ts`, `src/nodes/Node.ts`, and `src/nodes/Collection.ts` were modified. No unrelated files were changed. Limitation: the type-check command’s output did not provide independently observed test counters.

Implemented backward-compatible `anchorRange` support.

### Changes
- Parsed scalar, sequence, map, and empty-value nodes now receive:
  - `anchor: string`
  - `anchorRange: [start, end]`
- Ranges use zero-based UTF-16 offsets and include the complete anchor token.
- `anchorRange` is independent of `keepSourceTokens`.
- Aliases, unanchored nodes, and programmatically anchored nodes do not receive an own `anchorRange` property.
- `clone()` now copies `anchorRange` into a separate tuple.
- Public node typings and `ParsedNode` support the optional tuple.
- Existing tag/comment ordering, alias resolution, errors, ranges, and serialization paths were preserved.
- No files were added; only the six permitted files changed:
  - `/workspace/Blame/.blame/research/edit-boundaries-f31/f31/1-yaml-anchor-ranges-cline/workspace/src/compose/compose-node.ts`
